visual.issue: System message bubble uses hardcoded semantic colors: border-amber-400/20, bg-amber-400/[0.06], text-amber-100/90 — not design-token values
Streaming indicator uses hardcoded text-cyan-300 and bg-cyan-300 — should use a ds token (e.g. text-accent-info or text-stream)
Doubted item bar uses hardcoded from-amber-400/40 to-amber-400/0 gradient — not a ds token
Token item bar uses hardcoded from-cyan-400/40 to-cyan-400/0 gradient — not a ds token
Fallback 'model unknown' uses text-zinc-600 — not a ds token
Token counts and cost use text-zinc-500 — not a ds token
Detail popover background is hardcoded hex bg-[#0b0b0e] — should use bg-bg-base or a surface token
Popover text uses text-zinc-300 and border-white/10 — not ds tokens
Intervention buttons use text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200 — not ds tokens
Done checkmark uses text-emerald-400 — not a ds token (should be text-status-success or similar)
Zone fill colors use arbitrary bracket oklch values: bg-[oklch(0.7_0.15_140)], bg-[oklch(0.75_0.15_60)], bg-[oklch(0.65_0.2_25)] — not ds tokens
Zone text colors use arbitrary bracket oklch values: text-[oklch(0.7_0.15_140)], etc. — not ds tokens
Focus highlight animation adds hardcoded ring-amber-400 and ring-offset-zinc-950 classes via classList.add — not ds tokens
SecretaryToast container is fixed w-[480px] — may clip on narrow viewports or small sidebar configurations
Transcript Glass has max-h-[40vh] which may be very small on constrained layouts — messages near limit will be cut off without clear affordance
Token group expand/collapse button has no aria-label — only shows dynamic text (summary or 'Hide token stream'); non-visual users lack a stable label
Dismiss button renders only '✕' character — has aria-label='Dismiss secretary toast' so this is fine; no issue
ContextWindowMeter always displays 0% (usedTokens hardcoded to 0) — misleads user into thinking context is empty; the budget.used_tokens field is not wired from the getContextBudget payload
